{{Quote|Would you like your helmet serviced and cleaned while you wait for Madam Garsa?|The male server to Boba Fett and Fennec Shand|audio=WaitForGarsa.flac|<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" />}}
A [[Twi'lek]] [[Gender|male]] '''server''' worked for Madam [[Garsa Fwip]] at her [[cantina]], [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary]], on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. In [[9 ABY]], when the new [[crime lord]] [[Boba Fett]] and [[Master Assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]] visited the cantina, the Twi'lek server and a [[Unidentified Twi'lek female server|female colleague]] welcomed the pair and took their [[helmet]]s to be cleaned. They were present at the Sanctuary when the [[Hutt]] [[The Twins|twins]] visited the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]] and later when the [[bounty hunter]] [[Krrsantan]] assaulted a group of [[Trandoshan]] [[gambler]]s. They [[Death|perished]] within Garsa's Sanctuary when the [[Pyke Syndicate]] rigged a [[camtono]] to [[Destruction of Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|explode]] within the cantina.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Can we take your helmets for a cleaning?|The Twi'lek to the Pyke patrons|audio=HelmetCleaning.flac|<ref name="From the Desert Comes a Stranger">{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}}</ref>}}
[[File:Twilek_Servers_Greet_Fett_Shand.png|thumb|left|320px|The server and their colleague greeted the leaders of the new criminal empire.]]
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY date" /> a [[Twi'lek]]<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land-Audio Description" /> server worked for the Twi'lek Madam [[Garsa Fwip]]'s [[cantina]], the [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|Sanctuary]], within<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> the [[city]]<ref name="From the Desert Comes a Stranger" /> of [[Mos Espa]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. When the newly established [[crime lord]] [[Boba Fett]] and his<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land-Audio Description" /> partner, [[Master Assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]], visited the cantina, the Twi'lek server and a Twi'lek [[Unidentified Twi'lek female server|female colleague]] welcomed the pair and offered to clean their [[helmet]]s. While Shand initially refused, Fett accepted the offer and requested Shand's cleaned as well. The male took Shand's helmet while their female colleague took Fett's. When the crime lord and Fwip neared the end of their conversation, Fwip clapped to signal the servers to return with the helmets. After Fwip thanked Fett for his visit and departed, the servers returned their helmets. As the servers left, Shand noticed that Fett's helmet had been filled with [[New Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" />

During another visit from Fett and Shand, the server surveyed the cantina while the pair discussed an [[Ambush outside of the Sanctuary|assassination attempt]] on Fett with Fwip. When [[drum]]ming announced the arrival of the [[litter]] for previous crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s [[Hutt]] cousins, [[The Twins|twins]] [[Unidentified Hutt brother|brother]] and [[Unidentified Hutt sister|sister]], the male server's attention was drawn to the cantina's entrance along with the Sanctuary's patrons.<ref name="The Tribes of Tatooine">{{BOBF|Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine}}</ref> The Twi'lek was later present in the Sanctuary when<ref name="The Gathering Storm">{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}}</ref> the [[Wookiee]] [[bounty hunter]]<ref name="Krrsantan">{{Databank|krrsantan|Krrsantan}}</ref> [[Krrsantan]] assaulted a group of [[Trandoshan]] [[gambler]]s. The server witnessed Fwip attempt to calm the Wookiee down only for the hunter to rip an [[Limb|arm]] off [[Unidentified Trandoshan gambler|one]] of the gamblers.<ref name="The Gathering Storm" />

[[File:ServersReporttoGarza-BoBFCh6.png|thumb|right|320px|The Twi'lek and their colleague report to Fwip.]]
One [[Standard day|night]], as two [[Pyke Syndicate]] members entered the Sanctuary, the Twi'lek was present at the [[gambling]] table. When the [[Pyke]]s took their seats, the server approached the new patrons with their female colleague and offered to clean their helmets, but the two Twi'leks departed with the patrons' refusal. Upon returning to Fwip, the female server informed the Madam of the rejection, and the three Twi'leks then watched the Pykes leave the Sanctuary as a [[GS-C1B|server droid]] informed them they forgot their [[camtono]]. The camtono [[Destruction of Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|exploded]] soon after, [[Death|killing]] the server and others within the Sanctuary.<ref name="From the Desert Comes a Stranger" />

==Personality and traits==
The Twi'lek male had [[Color|green]] skin and brown [[eye]]s. They also had cone-shaped hearing [[Ear|organs]],<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> which were generally a characteristic of Twi'lek females.<ref name="Rebels Recon 2.07">{{SWYouTube|BqqeQEENm18|Rebels Recon #2.07: Inside "Blood Sisters" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-blood-sisters}}</ref> The server was obedient to Fwip, dutifully greeting visitors and offering helmet cleanings.<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" />

==Equipment==
The Twi'lek server wore a black [[Clothing|headwrap]] that covered the top of their head, their ears, and the base of their [[lekku]]. They had a [[necklace]] with two triangular plates resting against their chest. A brown band was on their left forearm, with [[bracelet]]s around both wrists. They had brown pants with a white fabric wrapped around their waist and draped in front of their legs, which wore dark brown [[boot]]s. A [[belt]] made of connecting circles was also on their waist.<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|But what I didn't expect obviously was the hype around whether my male Twi'lek role was trans or not.|Marlon Aquino on ''Force Geeks: A Star Wars Podcast''|<ref name="Force Geeks Interview">{{Audible|url=pd/Bonus-Ep-101-Full-Interview-with-Star-Wars-The-Book-of-Boba-Fett-Actor-Marlon-Aquino-the-Green-Twilek-Server-from-the-Sanctuary-Podcast/B09T98GLZN|text=Bonus Ep. 101: Full Interview with Star Wars The Book of Boba Fett Actor Marlon Aquino (the Green Twilek Server from the Sanctuary)|date=2022-02-24}}</ref>}}
[[File:MarlonAquino.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Twi'lek was played by actor Marlon Aquino.]]
The Twi'lek server appeared in the [[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land|premiere]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> on [[December 29]], [[2021]].<ref name="Disney+">{{DisneyPlusYouTube|t9Ca4ARSfqA|Next On Disney+ | December 2021}}</ref> The Twi'lek was credited as a "Twi'lek Server" and was played by [[Marlon Aquino]].<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" />

Aquino's audition for the Twi'lek was self-taped from home, and the audition was only communicated as a [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] project. He was informed after being accepted into the role that the project was ''[[Star Wars]]''–related but not for which show. Rather than a script, Aquino was only given the Twi'lek's lines to prepare. When Aquino was finally made aware of the role he would be playing, he was initially unfamiliar with Twi'leks and researched the [[species]] online, which took him to [[Wookieepedia]],<ref name="Force Geeks Interview" /> the free-to-edit, unofficial online ''Star Wars'' encyclopedia.<ref name="Wookieepedia">{{WookCite|url=Wookieepedia|text=Wookieepedia}}</ref>

The [[Wikipedia:COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19 pandemic]] pushed the start of filming for Aquino's role back by about a month. The actor had to arrive at the set as early as six in the morning for makeup and prosthetics to be applied, which took around two and a half hours. It took around five people to apply the mask, prosthetics, costume, and multiple layers of paint. An oil was applied to Aquino's skin to help smooth out the paint and removal of the paint took an hour and a half. Aquino spent as many as ten hours on set a day. He described the lekku prosthetics as a load that took getting used to wearing, and the large size of Aquino's head increased the difficulty of taking the lekku prosthetics on and off. Aquino spoke on the Force Geeks Podcast about how he was surprised at the fan speculation of his character being [[W:c:lgbtqia:Transgender|trans]]<ref name="Force Geeks Interview" /> based on the conal ears,<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|RuPalpsPodrace|status/1476116624130273281|date=2021-12-29|RuPalp's Podrace|quote=Who else saw the twi'lek dude with cone ears in #TheBookOfBobaFett ?? Trans twi'lek confirmed????|archivedate=20220506121734}}</ref> as Twi'lek women have usually been depicted with conal ears and Twi'lek men with [[human]]-like ears throughout the ''Star Wars'' [[canon]].<ref name="Rebels Recon 2.07" />

===Adaptation inconsistencies===
{{Quote|Would you like your helmets serviced and cleaned while you wait for Madam Garsa?|The Twi'leks' line in ''The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel''|<ref name="The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel">[[The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel|''The Book of Boba Fett'' Junior Novel]]</ref>}}
In the [[2023]] novelization of the series, ''[[The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel]]'', authored by [[Joe Schreiber]], a number of the Twi'lek's scenes are portrayed differently.<ref name="The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel" /> The server's line in "Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land" was changed from "your helmet"<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> to "your helmets" in the novelization.<ref name="The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel" /> While the male server gave Shand her helmet in Chapter 1,<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> the novelization had only one of the servers return both helmets, without specifying whom.<ref name="The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel" /> This article follows the events depicted in Chapter 1.
